summary.plain: The Soudan Underground Laboratory, 705 m down a disused iron mine in northern Minnesota: the historic shaft house on the surface and Level 27 below, home to the MINOS far detector and the CDMS II / SuperCDMS Soudan dark-matter experiments.
summary.technical: Local map for facility:soudan-underground-laboratory. Surface geometry is the NRHP-listed Soudan Mine shaft house from OpenStreetMap. The Level 27 laboratory is drawn as a surveyed point taken directly from the MINOS Collaboration's own published coordinate (PRD 76, 052003), reused verbatim from site:soudan-minos-far-detector; MINOS far detector, CDMS II and SuperCDMS Soudan all share this one position, having no independently sourced distinct footprint.
